qa_pairs.question: How many nations are co-hosting the 2026 FIFA World Cup, and which countries are they?
qa_pairs.answer: Three nations: the United States, Mexico, and Canada.
qa_pairs.full_answer: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is co-hosted by three nations: the United States, Mexico, and Canada.

qa_pairs.question: How many teams are participating in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, and how does this compare to previous tournaments?
qa_pairs.answer: 48 teams, which is an expansion from the previous 32-team format.
qa_pairs.full_answer: The 2026 FIFA World Cup includes 48 teams, which is an expansion from the previous 32-team format used in prior tournaments.

qa_pairs.question: Which country became the first to host or co-host the FIFA World Cup three times?
qa_pairs.full_answer: Mexico became the first country to host or co-host the FIFA World Cup three times, having previously hosted the 1970 and 1986 tournaments and now co-hosting in 2026.

qa_pairs.question: When did the 2026 FIFA World Cup begin and when is it scheduled to conclude?
qa_pairs.answer: It began on June 11, 2026, and is scheduled to conclude on July 19, 2026.
qa_pairs.full_answer: The 2026 FIFA World Cup began on June 11, 2026, and is scheduled to conclude on July 19, 2026.

qa_pairs.question: Which teams made their World Cup debut in the 2026 tournament?
qa_pairs.answer: Cape Verde, Curaçao, Jordan, and Uzbekistan.
qa_pairs.full_answer: Cape Verde, Curaçao, Jordan, and Uzbekistan all made their World Cup debuts in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

qa_pairs.question: What travel ban affected fans from how many countries during the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
qa_pairs.full_answer: A travel ban affected citizens of 39 countries during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, including World Cup participants Haiti, Iran, Ivory Coast, and Senegal.

qa_pairs.question: What happened to Somali referee Omar Artan during the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
qa_pairs.answer: He was denied entry and was unable to officiate at the tournament.
qa_pairs.full_answer: Somali referee Omar Artan was denied entry to the United States and was unable to officiate at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

qa_pairs.question: Why did the Iran national team relocate its training base before the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
qa_pairs.answer: Because the United States and Israel attacked Iran on February 28, 2026.
qa_pairs.full_answer: The Iran national team relocated its training base from Tucson, Arizona, to Tijuana, Mexico, because the United States and Israel attacked Iran on February 28, 2026.

qa_pairs.question: What was the maximum price listed for tickets to the final at MetLife Stadium during the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
qa_pairs.full_answer: Tickets to the final at MetLife Stadium were listed at up to $11,000 during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, drawing criticism from fans, politicians, and players.

qa_pairs.question: What was the visa bond requirement initially imposed on fans from five African nations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
qa_pairs.full_answer: Fans from five African nations were initially required to pay deposits of up to $15,000 as part of a visa bond program, though this requirement was temporarily suspended in May 2026 for ticketed fans.
